jobs.title: Hospitality Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description:
**Department:** Programs and Services


**FLSA Exemption Status:** full\-time, non\-exempt

**Location:** Denver, CO


**Supervisor:** Director of Essential Services

**Position Overview:**


The Hospitality Program Manager leads the programming and operations of The Gathering Place’s Hospitality Program, including the prepared foods program, food pantry, and clothing boutique. Leadership of this program requires promoting and maintaining a low barrier, trauma informed environment within the hospitality programs. The program manager leads and collaborates with Hospitality staff, volunteers, and other community partners to ensure low barrier access to high\-quality and nutritious food and essential clothing items. The program manager must operate with a broad understanding of the food and nutritional insecurities and essential needs of our community to deliver quality outcomes of the overall program.


You might be a great fit at TGP if you have a passion and commitment for our mission, the services we provide, and for addressing the systemic barriers that our members face through a trauma\-informed approach.

  



**Core Accountabilities:**

* Use cultural humility and trauma\-informed care when interacting with members, staff, volunteers, and community partners, including mindfulness and flexibility regarding food preferences, sensitivities, and needs.
* Maintain a physically and psychologically safe environment for members, staff, and volunteers.
* Lead inventory management for the hospitality program; lead and execute regular ordering processes in order to ensure kitchen supplies and ingredients remain fully stocked, while remaining within the establish program budget.
* Create and lead strong systems and protocols that are consistent with the objectives of TGP’s clothing boutique and food pantry programs
* Create weekly menus reflecting a wide variety of cultural influences and dietary needs. Engage with and lead Hospitality staff, volunteers, and meal sponsors in the daily production and serving of high\-quality meals, as well as needs related to the Boutique and Pantry as they arise.
* Complete all program documentation and data entry in a timely manner to meet organizational, legal, and contractual standards and reporting requirements.
* Ensure compliance with operational standards, health department regulations, and all federal/state/local laws.
* Provide supportive 1:1 supervision to all program staff that focuses on performance, growth, and progress.
* Work as a member of the program manager team to resolve issues across TGP programs, coordinate resources, and provide organizational leadership
* Coordinate scheduling of staff, volunteers, and community partners to promote effective and efficient program operations
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor

 **Compensation \& Benefits:**

* 37\.5\-hour workweek
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Life insurance plans
* 403(b) retirement savings plan
* Financial advising services
* Generous paid time off
* Long\- and short\-term disability plan
* Robust training and professional development opportunities
* Free breakfast and lunch
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free CorePower Yoga membership

 **About The Gathering Place:**


Founded in 1986, The Gathering Place (TGP) supports women, gender\-diverse people, and their children in building stable lives through home, health, purpose, and community programs. We are driven by our values of community, safety, inclusivity, empowerment, and hope. We envision a Colorado where all marginalized groups experiencing homelessness and instability have pathways to security.


As a trauma\-informed, low\-barrier organization, we remove unnecessary or harmful requirements that prevent members of the community from accessing our services when they need them most—from essential services like meals, showers, and laundry to long\-term support like housing\-focused case management and physical, mental, and sexual health care. Members choose which of our services they want to take advantage of, giving them the autonomy they need to rebuild their lives.


Requirements:
**Requirements:**

* Able to bend, lift, push, pull, and hold/carry at least 15 lbs.
* Able to perform job duties in a variety of fluctuating temperatures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Current knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, food justice and food and nutritional insecurity.
* Compassionate and empathetic approach to working with diverse populations.
* Current knowledge of, or willingness to learn, how to operate a computer and other office machinery, such as a copy machine or printer, and office software, such as Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and other programs.
* Preferred: Minimum three years of experience in food service or in a food service/culinary training program.
* Preferred: Minimum of one year of experience in a supervisory role.
* Preferred: Knowledge of, or lived experience with, homelessness, poverty, women and trans issues, substance misuse.


If you’re excited about this role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with the requirements in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this or other roles within the organization!

 **Commitment to Equity and Inclusion:**


The Gathering Place is committed to Accessibility, Belonging, Liberation, and Equity (ABLE) work to advance marginalized communities from oppression, exploitation, and discrimination while uplifting and celebrating them. We are taking collective action towards dismantling systemic structures and empowering underrepresented identities.


TGP is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a policy of non\-discrimination and equal opportunity for all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, gender variance, gender expression, marital status, citizenship, creed,

jobs.description:

With a mission to affirm life at every step of the journey with illness and loss, TRU provides a continuum of care through TRU Hospice, TRU PACE (Program of All\-Inclusive Care for the Elderly), TRU Palliative Care, TRU Grief Services, and Landmark Memory Care.
  
  

**Position:** PACE Clinic RN Case Manager
  
**Schedule:** Monday\-Friday, 8am\-5pm
  
**Location:** Primarily Lafayette, CO in a clinic environment
  
**Pay:** $88,067 to $105,680 per year
  
**Sign\-On Bonus:** $6,000
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
The PACE Clinic RN provides skilled nursing care to PACE program participants. They work with other clinic staff in the provision of medical and nursing care, ensuring the highest quality of care in accordance with PACE policy and applicable regulations. While case management and care coordination are a big part of the role, you will also be hands\-on with patients regularly.

To learn more about TRU Community Care, please visit www.trucare.org.

The mission of the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless is to work collaboratively toward the prevention of homelessness and the creation of lasting solutions for homeless and at\-risk families, children, and individuals throughout Colorado. The Coalition advocates for and provides a continuum of housing and a variety of services to improve the health, well\-being, and stability of those it serves.

**Our Philosophy of Service:** We believe all people have the right to adequate housing and health care. We work to remove the barriers that restrict access to these rights. * Honoring the inherent dignity of those we serve, affirming their capabilities and fostering their hope that a better life is possible.


* Building strong, caring and trauma\-informed communities through the integration of housing, health care and supportive services.


* Advocating for social and racial equity, inclusion and diversity, and challenging the status quo in partnership with our workforce members and those we serve.


* Achieving excellence through continuous quality assurance, innovation and professional development.


* Using resources judiciously and effectively.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**About Momentum360**

Momentum360 is a rapidly growing nonprofit serving individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability, and recovery needs across the Denver Metro area.

We believe support should be accessible, practical, and built on real relationships. Every week our team provides outreach, case management, transportation assistance, phones, vital document support, and resource navigation that help people move toward long\-term stability.

**Position Summary**

Momentum360 is seeking a compassionate, organized, and highly motivated **Case Manager** to provide individualized support for community members experiencing homelessness or housing instability.

This position combines field outreach with structured case management. You'll build relationships, complete assessments, coordinate services, document progress, and help clients overcome barriers to housing, healthcare, employment, and recovery.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable meeting someone at an outreach event as they are documenting services, tracking outcomes, and managing multiple client cases.

**Responsibilities**  
Client Case Management

* Conduct client intakes and comprehensive needs assessments
* Develop individualized service plans
* Connect clients with housing, healthcare, behavioral health, employment, transportation, identification documents, and public benefits
* Maintain regular client follow\-up and monitor progress
* Coordinate referrals with community partners

Outreach \& Engagement

* Participate in street outreach and community events
* Build trusting relationships with vulnerable populations
* Meet clients where they are while maintaining healthy professional boundaries
* Support crisis intervention when appropriate

Documentation \& Data

* Maintain accurate case notes and service documentation
* Track client outcomes and program metrics
* Utilize Google Workspace to organize client information
* Create and maintain spreadsheets for reporting and data tracking
* Ensure documentation meets HIPAA standards

Collaboration

* Work closely with healthcare providers, shelters, housing agencies, treatment providers, and community organizations
* Attend team meetings and case consultations
* Represent Momentum360 professionally in the community

QualificationsRequired

* Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, or related field
* 1\+ years of case management or human services experience
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, recovery, behavioral health, or housing instability
* Proficiency with **Google Sheets**, Google Docs, Google Drive, and Google Workspace
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Preferred

* Knowledge of Medicaid, Medicare, and Colorado public benefits
* Experience with electronic health records or case management software
* Familiarity with Denver\-area community resources

Pay: $20\.50 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Denver, CO 80205

jobs.title: Intensive Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
The vision of Colorado Access is to have healthy communities transformed by the care that people want at a cost we can all afford. Our mission is to partner with communities and empower people through access to quality, affordable care.
  
  

Why should you consider a career with Colorado Access?
  
We are a Colorado\-based company, working to improve the health of our state. We care for individuals, families, and children who receive health care under Child Health Plan Plus (CHP\+) and Health First Colorado (Colorado's Medicaid Program). Our focus is driving improvements in quality, member experience, outcomes, and cost. We are a mission\-driven organization whose foundation is built by our vision, supported by our values and pillared by diversity, equity and inclusion.
  
**1\. Find work/life balance:** We offer PTO, floating holidays, nine company paid holidays, a hybrid work environment, an Employee Assistance Program and a 401K.
  
**2\. Be a part of something bigger and make an impact:** We serve the underserved and most vulnerable populations in our community through access to quality and affordable health care. No matter what you do for Colorado Access, you are impacting our community and making a difference.
  
**3\. Sharpen your skills, learn, and grow:** We support your continued development through tuition reimbursement, leadership training, promotion opportunities, performance evaluations, employee recognition, and a language pay stipend.
  
  

**What you will do:**  

We are looking for a INTENSIVE CARE COORDINATOR who can help shape our vision and support our mission. Here is what the position will look like.
  
* Ability to support members with complex health care needs from a holistic point of view (including behavioral health, physical health, co\-occurring disorders, and social determinants of health).
* Performs comprehensive clinical assessments and applies clinical knowledge of emotional disorders, chronic health conditions, medication issues, substance use disorders, communicable diseases, advance directives, and other health concerns to best support the member.
* Develop strengths\-based care plans with members and their natural support if applicable.
* Implement care plans through coordinating services and interventions by referring, educating, and collaborating with members and their care team.
* Performs ongoing care plan goal review to ensure alignment with the members intrinsic motivation and needs.
* Assists in identification of risk factors leading to increased utilization and works to reduce preventable hospitalizations, readmissions, and inappropriate utilization.
* Establishes professional and member focused collaboration, communication, and coordination among all responsible parties of the member’s care team.
* Actively participates in clinical presentations and or/interdisciplinary team meetings, disposition planning, and department and organizational meetings.
* Establishes professional and effective collaboration, communication, and coordination among all responsible parties of an individual member’s interdisciplinary care team.
* As needed, attends member focused meetings (internal/external) such as interdisciplinary team (IDT), creative solutions (CS), or complex service solutions (CSS).
* Effectively manages communication across the member’s treatment team, including the facilitation of collaborative treatment planning meetings and all related follow\-up communication and documentation.
* Educates members regarding current state plan and capitated behavioral health plan benefits, programs, options and services.
* Meets performance, quality, customer service, and coordination standards assigned by the department management team.
* Assists members and providers in understanding the complaint, grievance and appeal process.
* Participate in training and staff development opportunities.
* Provides clinical consultation and guidance to care coordination staff.
* Actively participates in team meetings and communicates progress and barriers with the Supervisor and/or Department Manager.
* Coordinates for members who have had behavioral health or medical admission, supports the hospital with discharge planning and collaborating with hospitals and facilities for seamless continuity.
* Liaising between the Providers, family and treatment team and the RAE Utilization Management, billing and Provider relations teams.
* Contribute to deliverables and reports when needed.


**What you will bring:**  

**Education:** Master’s degree in social work, human behavioral sciences field or another healthcare field and/or BSN with clinical license (RN) is required. A combination of bachelor’s degree in related fields, plus 8 years of progressive work experience in social work, case management or behavioral health related fields can be substituted in lieu of master’s degree. Experience: Three years of clinical, care management and/or healthcare experience required. Preferred experience in clinical inpatient, outpatient, or community health settings.
  
  

**Experience:** working with Medicare and Medicaid populations, and related social/economic issues delivering care management services, conducting assessments, interviewing members, developing service plans, coordinating care and monitoring services for members also preferred.
  
  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** Knowledge of clinical care coordination and utilization management. Ability to perform clinical assessments and develop clinical care plans. Knowledge of and ability to establish and maintain connections with members of diverse populations and provide culturally sensitive services. Ability to process a high volume of work efficiently with a high level of customer service detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational and time management skills, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to handle and prioritize multiple tasks and/or respond to time\-sensitive request

jobs.title: Care Coordinator I (Client Care)
jobs.description:
**Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare.** Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. **Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.**  

Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.  

As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first\-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best\-in\-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.  

Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human\-to\-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.  


The Care Coordination Team’s objective is to facilitate a frictionless experience for both clients and clinicians working with  

Headlight. Clinicians work with Headlight because we take care of the important administrative parts of their job for them.  

Clients come to Headlight because we ensure they are matched with world\-class mental health providers, and we make it  

easy to get the help they need without jumping through hoops or feeling frustrated. And our Care Coordination team is  

the engine that makes this all happen.

As a Client Care Coordinator, you serve as a vital link between our clients and clinical team, ensuring that each care plan  

is executed seamlessly. You’ll do this by aligning clinician availability with client needs by managing calendars,  

rescheduling appointments, and optimizing clinician schedules for maximum efficiency. You will also act as the first  

point of contact for client inquiries through phone, text, and email—delivering timely, compassionate, and professional  

support. You will support our clinicians by keeping them informed of relevant updates, schedule changes, and client  

preferences to help them deliver the best care possible. This role is essential in fostering a smooth, supportive care  

experience for both clients and clinicians by ensuring communication is clear, plans are followed, and needs are  

proactively met.
### **Our Pillars**

* **Make things easier.**
* **Forge genuine connections.**
* **Elevate the standard.**

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Client Care Coordination: Facilitate the execution of a Clinician developed care plan for clients in need of outpatient mental health services; answer calls, reply to text messages \& emails, and assist clients in their scheduling needs.
* Clinical Support: Provide administrative support to clinicians and their clients by backing up the Clinical Support Team. This includes assisting with documentation, scheduling logistics, and any other operational needs that contribute to seamless care delivery.
* Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Clinical, Billing, and Intake Teams to ensure continuity of care and streamlined communication. Help facilitate efficient teamwork by acting as a liaison across departments.
* Resource Coordination: Assist clients in navigating the healthcare system by coordinating services both within Headlight and externally. Tasks may include rescheduling appointments, coordinating with pharmacies, resolving insurance or billing issues, and connecting clients with necessary medical or mental health resources.
* Monitoring and Follow\-Up: Regularly track client progress and ensure care is delivered according to established plans. Complete follow\-ups after appointments, confirm future visits are scheduled, and carry out all assigned tasks related to client care coordination.
* Client Satisfaction: Serve as a reliable, empathetic point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs are met and their experience with Headlight is supportive, professional, and responsive.
* Data Entry, Tasking, and Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records by entering information into the system in a timely and detailed manner. Track tasks, document client interactions, and ensure all care coordination is properly logged.
* Compliance with Policies: Uphold all organizational policies and procedures. Ensure client care meets high professional standards and complies with legal, ethical, and HIPAA requirements.

### **Qualifications**

* Previous experience in a medical/mental health office, specifically with scheduling and referral coordination
* Working knowledge of Electronic Medical Records Systems
* Experience with Excel, Word, and other computer programs
* Ability to work with a team with little direct supervision
* Excellent communication skills through phone, email, text and chat
* Customer service experience (2 years preferred)
* Ability to be flexible in a fast paced, evolving work environment
* Attendance as required for position.
* Problem solving skills
* Possess a strong collaborative attitude that applies solution\-based thinking

jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Dividend
jobs.description:
**About the Fund for Guaranteed Income**

The Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI) directs power and resources into the hands of the people — so everyone can determine the course of their lives.

We partner with community organizations and governments to run pilot programs that reimagine systems, including the social safety net and the criminal legal system, and advocate for more efficient, dignified, and inclusive forms of support.

To date, most of our work involves direct cash transfers. We built the Compton Pledge — the largest city\-based guaranteed income program in US history — and have supported more than 20 pilot programs nationwide. We design and implement pilot programs, build technology, and conduct research to make the case for policies that meaningfully expand support.

Beyond cash, we build tools that address the broader needs of the communities we serve. Over the past five years, our positive\-impact technology projects have assisted some of the hardest\-to\-reach community members.

**About the AI Dividend**

AI is impacting jobs that provide security and mobility for millions of Americans. Yet our ability to respond is at a particularly weak point, hurt by uncertainty about the speed and scale of AI's impact.

Fortunately, we don't need to know the future to start preparing.

The AI Dividend is a pilot program that provides income support and reskilling to workers displaced by AI, generating data needed for an effective response. We are exploring:

* How to identify AI displacement on an individual level
* How workers navigate and overcome AI displacement
* How income support can support the road to re\-employment

The AI Dividend is the latest program from the Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI), a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization that has run more than 20 cash transfer programs nationwide.

**The AI Dividend is not a guaranteed income pilot program.** We aim to test both cash and alternative forms of support to understand what displaced workers are asking for — and what really helps people overcome AI displacement.

**The role**

The AI Dividend is seeking a member of the founding team to help build this program from the ground up. As Program Manager, you will work directly with F4GI's Executive Director and our core team to keep the program organized, remove distractions, and solve problems so we can learn as much as possible from each stage of the program and scale.

The AI Dividend is run by a small, core team. Like a startup, every person wears multiple hats and is expected to play a role in different areas of the project.

Your work will be concentrated in:

* **Program Operations**: Making sure the program is running smoothly, finding and proposing solutions to pain points.
* **Program Design**: Connecting with directly impacted workers, workforce development providers, and AI researchers to ensure their input and expertise are built into the DNA of this program.
* **Program Strategy**: Helping us stay connected to what is most important and triage between competing priorities.

Your work will also touch on:

* **Fundraising**: Supporting our team in finding partners interested in supporting our growth.
* **Research**: Coordinating research activities (interviews, surveys) and keeping outputs organized.
* **External Communications**: Contributing to our work sharing the impact and stories from this program more broadly.

**How do I know if I'm a good fit?**

The AI Dividend is being built in real time — the work involves a lot of unknowns and experimentation. We are looking for someone with:

* experience in a small startup or similar fast\-paced environment who is comfortable working with uncertainty and ambiguity
* a demonstrated track record of making good decisions, quickly, with limited information — and pivoting when things don't work out
* a bias for action and a love of feedback — you understand the concept of "best right now"
* a strong personal organization system — you ask questions and gather context intuitively so you always know what is most important

**Onboarding will be limited.** You will be expected to figure out systems and ask questions so you can hit the ground running.

You are expected to use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT daily. Ideal applicants are highly proficient with these tools — you have developed your own workflows and can help the team level up. Comfort with tools like Cursor is a bonus.

You are actively engaged with AI as a topic — reading, thinking, discussing, following the field. AI policy or research is a strong plus, but you don't need to have formal research or policy experience as long as you bring useful and interesting perspectives to the team. You are an excellent candidate if you can help us connect to the right partners throughout the AI space.

**How to apply**

Email careers@f4gi.org with the subject line "Program Manager — \[Your Name]" and include:

* **Your resume and LinkedIn profile.**
* **Three professional references** — we will not contact them without speaking with you first.
* **Short answers** to the following:
* What experience do you believe prepares you well to work on this team?
* What are a few examples of how you've used AI in the last week?
* Which writers or thinkers about AI would you recommend to our team, and why?
* What is one AI development from the last six months that changed how you think about work?
* What tools or techniques do you use to stay organized?

Bullets and short answers are fine and encouraged. We care more about the clarity and strength of your answer than how polished it is. Using AI to draft your answers is fine, but please be aware that many people do this and the results all tend to look similar.

* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Proficiency with healthcare systems, EHRs, and reporting tools.
* Experience driving technology\-enabled workflow improvements, particularly with AI/LLM tools.

**Gamesight empowers the industry’s top game makers through data, technology, and experiences.**
================================================================================================


Gamesight builds technology to help kickass games find commercial success. We do this by empowering game publishers with data so they can better understand their community, players, and game performance. We specialize in Measurement \& Attribution, Influencer Activations, Creator Programs, and Creator\-Led Playtests, all tailored to meet the unique needs of each game at every stage of its lifecycle.

  

At Gamesight, we're looking for someone who eats, sleeps, and breathes the gaming creator space, and who's adaptable enough to jump into virtually anything, do ALL the sidequests, and level up multiple stats at a time. If you're the kind of person who always has a tab open on the latest creators and another on a Discord server you're quietly moderating for fun, this role was made for you.

* Clear, timely, and professional communication.
* Confident in relationship building with high\-value/high\-impact creators and customers.
* Top\-tier organization skills. You can juggle multiple programs, creator communications, and deadlines without dropping the ball.
* Excited and open\-minded to learn new skills.
* Ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information and respect privacy and non\-disclosure terms for our customers, vendors, and employees.
* A love of video, tabletop, and/or trading card games and a genuine enthusiasm for the gaming industry.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with Asana or other project management tooling. ✨
* Ability to speak a language in addition to English. ️

  

Success in 30 Days

* You ship something, build something, or write something for your role on day 1\.
* You are familiar with Gamesight's policies, guidelines, team structure, and tool stack \- you can navigate independently.
* You have access to all tools and resources required to be effective and understand how they fit into Gamesight's workflows.
* You understand Gamesight's methodology and approach to creator programs and creator communities.

* You maintain clean and up\-to\-date Asana updates for the rest of your team.

Why Gamesight?


Gamesight empowers publishers to build strong communities, engage the right influencers, and effectively measure marketing performance against actual sales and installs.
